FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited for the following positions at DST - Centre for Policy
Research (CPR) at Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Name of post: Project Scientist I
No. of Vacancy: 1
Salary : Rs. 56,000/- + HRA as applicable
Nature of post: Temporary and co-terminus with project
Essential Qualification:
1. Ph. D in the field of Science OR Master’s degree in Engineering or Technology from a
recognized university.
2. Experience (One year after Ph.D and Two year after M.Tech/ME) in research and development
in Industrial or Academic institutions or Science and Technology organizations.
3. Age: Less than 35 years
Desirable:
i. S&T policy Knowledge
ii. knowledge of Intellectual Property Rights.
iii. Experience of preparing detailed document, report, etc.
iv. Knowledge of Statistical tools and infographics.
Name of post: Project Scientist II
No. of Vacancies: 2
Salary : Rs. 67,000/- + HRA as applicable
Nature of post: Temporary and co-terminus with project
Essential Qualification:
1. Ph. D in the field of Science OR Master’s degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized
university
2. Experience (three years after Ph.D and four years after M.Tech/ME) in research and development
in Industrial or Academic institutions or science and technology organizations and scientific
activities and services with proven knowledge of Intellectual Property Rights.
3. Age: Less than 40 years
Desirable: The candidate should have
i. S&T policy knowledge and experience
ii. Experience of preparing detailed documents, reports, etc.
iii. Hands on Experience in website management (Development, Maintenance and Updating),
Network Maintenance and Troubleshooting.
iv. Hands on Experience in Flash/Multimedia/Photoshop Software/infographics.
Name of post: Project Scientist III
No. of Vacancy: 2
Salary : Rs. 78,000/- + HRA as applicable
Nature of post: Temporary and co-terminus with project
Essential Qualification:
1. Ph. D in the field of Science OR Master’s degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized
university
2. Experience (Seven years after Ph.D and Eight years after M.Tech/ME) in research and
development in Industrial or Academic institutions or Science and Technology organizations.
Experience in scientific activities and services with proven knowledge of Intellectual Property
Rights.
3. Age: Less than 45 years
Desirable: The candidate should have
i. S&T policy knowledge and experience
ii. Experience in Handling projects, preparing detailed documents, reports, etc.
iii. Leadership qualities to Guide a team of Project Scientists and Project Associates
iv. A good research record evidenced by publications (research papers, review articles, book
chapters, books etc) in reputed international journals and publication houses.
v. Should be able to make and present reports/data/presentations in MS word, Excel,
PowerPoint, etc.
Conditions:
1. Candidates are advised to send the complete application along with essential
documents/proofs in support of claims as hard copy to the “Coordinator, DST Centre for
Policy Research, Room no 410, top floor, Guru Teg Bahadur Bhawan, Sector 14, Panjab
University, Chandigarh-160014”.
2. The CV and the additional information asked is to be sent only in the prescribed proforma
enclosed as attachment-1. Do not send your application/CV via e-mail. It will not be
entertained.
3. The application will be rejected if it is not sent in the prescribed proforma, or is incomplete.
4. Teaching will not be considered as research experience.
5. Candidates applying for different posts should submit separate applications. If it is not
complied, the application form will be rejected.
6. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail for the Interview.
7. The last date for the submission of application is 03.08.2023 till 5 pm.
8. For Query, please contact at Tel No:- 0172-2534124 between 2:00 pm to 3:00 pm.
